_readme: Queue of social posts. status: draft -> scheduled -> published (or failed). The recurring agent only touches entries with status 'scheduled' whose date has arrived, and never re-publishes an entry once it is 'published'. Add new entries with status 'scheduled' to queue future posts; set status 'draft' to keep something out of the run until you approve it.
